stories.headline: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
stories.summary: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

stories.headline: Hot inflation reading sets stage for possible Fed rate hike next week
Consumer outlook plunges in September as inflation outlook worsens
stories.summary: The survey's headline index hit a level of 47.8, down 7.5% from the August reading and off 13.2% from a year ago.

stories.headline: Trump proposal to tie trade policy to Federal Reserve rate cuts could face long - term economic challenges

stories.summary: In August, consumer prices rose 3.4% over the past year while wages increased just 3.1%.
